title: v1.1.6 - Sync, Sounds & Study
text:
- Added cloud sync: sign in to save and load your data on any device
- Added Translate
- Added Dictionary with definitions, synonyms and pronunciation
- Added Converter for units, temperature and live currency
- Added Graphing calc with pan, zoom and trace
- Added Reference: periodic table, formulas and constants
- Added Markdown notes with folders and search
- Added Countdown card in the left sidebar
- Added OS Hub section with a StormOS launcher
- Added Ctrl+K command palette that opens any tool by name
- Added shortcut list, opened with ? key
- Added UI sounds and a keyboard-key sound on hover
- Added click ripples and smoother tile and button animations
- Moved Fun to the top
- Removed the What's new tile (the version button in the corner still opens it)
- Removed the owner-only setup text from Games
- Fixed a startup error that could happen with Settings open

title: v1.1.4 - GAMES!
text:
So I am now moving from the games site over to the new SGS OS system and it will now have all of the games instead of it being a blockable Google site. Now there are 2 ways (technically 3) to run the OS:
1. The SGS OS Loader html file
2. The launcher in the current Google site.
3. If your school somehow hasn't blocked Github pages then ig you can run it thru the GH page.
